items.source: Select the item to recharge
items.target: 选择要充能的物品

items.source: Not enough money
items.target: 金钱不足

items.source: This costs %d gold.
items.target: 这将花费%d金币。

items.source: Recharge?
items.target: 充能？

items.source: This will cost you %d gold.
items.target: 这将花费你%d金币。

items.source: Welcome, @playername@, to my shop.
items.target: 欢迎来我的商店，@playername@。

items.source: Let me see your wares.
items.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

items.source: I want to recharge some of my equipment.
items.target: 我想要充能我的一些物品。

items.source: Sorry, I have to go!
items.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

items.source: What just happened?!
items.target: 刚才发生了什么？！

items.source: I'm sorry I didn't manage to protect you and as you were about to die you... fired a powerful wave of blight.
items.target: 抱歉，刚才我没能保护住你，而就在你快要死去的时候……你发射出了一道强大的枯萎能量波。

items.source: But I have never cast a spell in my life!
items.target: 但我从来没施过法啊！

items.source: You are still tainted by that ... foul Demon! The taint is not all gone!
items.target: 你肯定被污染了...对,那个恶魔！污染还没有被清除干净！

items.source: There must be some of that demon's taint still inside you.
items.target: 你身体里还存在着恶魔的污染。

items.source: This is terrible! I assure you I had no idea this would happen. You must trust me!
items.target: 怎么会！我发誓，什么都不知道，你要相信我！一定要！

items.source: I do. The Ziguranth are not raving zealots, you know. We will look for a way to cure you, as long as you reject the blight.
items.target: 我相信。伊格兰斯不是杀人狂魔，我们会找到方法来治疗你的，只要你拒绝接受这股枯萎能量。

items.source: This is terrible! What is happening to me?!? You must help me!
items.target: 天啊!到底发生了什么?!?你一定要帮我!

items.source: I will. We will find a cure for this together.
items.target: 我当然会帮你。我们一起来想办法。

items.source: I'm a very lucky girl, am I not... This is the second time I've had you to save me now.
items.target: 我真是幸运的女孩，不是吗... 这是你第二次拯救我了。

items.source: Over the last weeks you've become very important to me, and I am glad to have you. This is certainly not the place to talk, though, let's go.
items.target: 最近的几个星期里，你对我非常重要，有你在身边我很高兴。不过，这里显然不是说话的地方，我们走吧。

items.source: You're right, let's get out of here.
items.target: 你说得对！快点离开这。

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[go back to Last Hope]
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[回到最后的希望]

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two of you spend some time relaxing on the beach.
The air is fresh, the sand shimmers, and the surf roars softly.*#WHITE#

This was such a lovely idea!
I have had a wonderful time with you today.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks longingly into your eyes.*#WHITE#
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你们两个在沙滩上放松了一阵子。
空气清新无比，阳光照射在砂砾上，闪耀五颜六色的光芒，
耳边传来海浪轻柔地呼啸。*#WHITE#

出来旅行真好！
今天和你玩得很开心啊。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她含情脉脉地凝视着你。*#WHITE#

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Lean closer and kiss her]#WHITE#
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[你靠了过去，亲吻了她]#WHITE#

items.source: Just before your lips touch, you sense that something is very wrong.
items.target: 在你们俩嘴唇相碰之前，你注意到有什么不对劲……

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Continue...]#WHITE#
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[继续...]#WHITE#

items.source: Hi, sweety!
items.target: 嗨亲爱的！

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[kiss her]#WHITE#
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[亲吻她]#WHITE#

items.source: Are you settling in fine?
items.target: 你过得好么？

items.source: I want to open my own little shop in Derth?
items.target: 我想在德斯镇开店？

items.source: I want to study magic at Angolwen?
items.target: 我想去安格利文学魔法？

items.source: I want to train at Zigur?
items.target: 我想去伊格兰斯训练？

items.source:
Well let me say that tank is #{bold}#dreadful#{normal}#, but that weird butler says it is the only way.
I do start to feel better too.
However I must say I get bored around here a little.
Do you remember, I once told you %s Maybe we could find a way to get me there during the day and return for my treatment during the night?
items.target:
好吧，那个通道确实有些#{bold}#可怕#{normal}#，不过那个长相奇怪的管家说那是唯一的路。
现在我觉得好多了。
不过，呆久了还是觉得有些无聊。
你还记得么,我曾经说过“%s”，或许能想个办法，白天出去，晚上再回来？

items.source: Oh yes, I think we could arrange that. Shadow, would it be possible to create a portal for her?
items.target: 当然可以，我相信我们能做到。堡垒幻影，能为她制造一个传送门么？

items.source:
Yes Master. I will arrange for that right now.
She will be able to come and go unnoticed.
items.target:
是的，主人。我马上做。
她将能够无声无息地来往于两地之间。

items.source: That is perfect.
items.target: 很好。

items.source: Oh this is great, thank you! My own secret lair, my own life.
items.target: 噢，太棒了！谢谢！属于我自己的秘密巢穴，属于我自己的人生。

items.source: I only wish your happiness, I am glad to provide.
items.target: 只要你过得幸福，我什么都愿意做。

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Looking all glamorous she comes closer*#WHITE#
Now my sweet one, where were we the last time?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*看上去充满魅力，梅琳达走近了你*#WHITE#
亲爱的，我们上次进行到哪儿了？

items.source: My memory fails me, care to help me remember? #LIGHT_GREEN#[smile playfully at her]
items.target: 我都忘了，你能帮我想起来么？#LIGHT_GREEN#[你调皮地笑着]
